findings: Owner request 2026-11-10: practice short questions for Unit 13 in the same format as the other books' chapter practice, long questions in the Mathematics Board Section-II shape (5-mark parts) (English and Roman Urdu), written from the unit; not printed in the book. 49 questions numbered 1-49; by section: 13.1 5, 13.2 3, 13.2.1 3, 13.3.1 4, 13.3.2 7, 13.4 6, 13.5 4, 13.6 11, 13.7 6.

Covers sections 13.1-13.7 in book order: definitions (secant, tangent, derivative, differentiable, notations), first-principles derivatives, the power rule, differentiability of |x|-type functions, the rules of 13.6 and small applications. All functions and numbers are our own (none repeats the unit's examples or exercises); every answer and every intermediate step was checked by computation in Python (sympy, check13_short.py). Book corrections followed: secant line, Newton's dot above the letter, f'(0) (not f'(x)) for |x|, right-hand limit as dx -> 0+.
Every question carries a book_ref (topic id and exact words of that topic's English lesson), verified by tools.py.
The Roman Urdu file has the same checkpoints, order and book_refs; each prompt keeps the English question with the Roman Urdu meaning in brackets.
Drafts for the academic review (second-person review before publication).
